key-on-the-pdf-digest.why: Decision 149 §٤ rules the PDF digest out by name. The render is not byte-stable, so keying identity on it makes every download a new document -- the defect message 44 shipped and its e2e caught.

revert-to-the-message-44-key.from:
fileName: input.fileName,
        content: { is: { issuedFactsSha256: input.issuedFactsSha256 } },
revert-to-the-message-44-key.why: (policy, file name) alone is stable across a CHANGE to the policy, so a certificate issued after an endorsement is mistaken for the first one and never stored. This is exactly the state decision 149 exists to end.

inherit-the-previous-copys-stamp.why: Criterion 4 -- each copy carries the stamp of ITS OWN issuance. A copy that inherited the stamp beside it would tell an inspector the office was under study on a day it was not. The e2e CANNOT catch this (both values are NULL there), which is why the unit spec exists.

store-the-second-copy-unchained.why: «بجانب القديمة» recorded as two unrelated rows a reader must order by createdAt and hope, rather than in the version chain the schema already carries.
